provenance.source: PNOA, Instituto Geográfico Nacional (orthophoto of July 2023, 25 cm)
provenance.notes: Ends of the painted line across the main straight, in front of the control tower, from the left edge line to the pit wall side, looking south-south-east in the direction of travel. Checked against GPS laps: every lap crosses it once, heading south-south-east; passes through the pit lane do not.

Official length 3,850 m. The circuit does not publish dates for earlier layouts (the original track was shorter), so the layout has a single version; the 2015 to 2021 works renewed the buildings and resurfaced the track without changing the layout.
